== History ==
In ``{{ill|Izumo no Kuni Fudoki|de|Izumo Fudoki|ja|出雲国風土記|simple|Izumo-no-Kuni Fudoki|zh|出雲國風土記|qid=Q11395858}}'', there is a description that Susanoo no Mikoto came to this area after cultivating various areas, did the final cultivation, and said, ``This is a good country, so I will name the land, not Iwaki,'' and named it ``Susa'' to soothe his soul. Since ancient times, it has been considered the main shrine of Susanoo no Mikoto. The Susa clan of {{ill|Shake (social class)|id|Shake (kelas sosial)|ja|社家|qid=Q11588367}} is said to have descended from {{ill|Kayanarumi no Kami|ja|カヤナルミ|zh|賀夜奈流美命|qid=Q11294873|lt=Kayana-ryu Mime}}, the son of {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Ōkuninushi}}.

The former site of the shrine is said to have been on Mt. Miyao to the north of the shrine. The current shrine site is located almost in the center of the basin, and it is thought that it was already in this area during the Middle Ages.

It is described as ``Sosa Shrine'' in ``Izumo-no-Kuni Fudoki.'' In the ``{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}}'', it is listed as ``Susa Shrine'' and is listed as a small shrine. In the medieval period, it was called ``Jusansho Daimyojin'' and ``Omiya Daimyojin,'' and in the early modern period, it was called ``Susa Omiya.''

== Facilities ==
; Main shrine, Heiden, Worship hall
:: The main shrine is a cultural property designated by Shimane Prefecture and was built in 1861. |publisher=Shimane Prefecture Education Agency Cultural Properties Division}}</ref>. It is a {{ill|Taisha-zukuri|fr|Taisha-zukuri|ja|大社造|ru|Тайся-дзукури|tr|Taisha-zukuri|zh|大社造|qid=Q387874}} building with a width of 2 rooms (approximately 4 m) and a height of approximately 12 m, and there is a floor (kizahashi) that serves as the entrance to the 1 room on the right. <ref>{{Cite web|Japanese book|url=https://www.susa-jinja.jp/information/8 |title=Gohonden (designated as an important prefectural cultural property) |access-date=2022-07-13 |publisher=Susa Shrine Official}}</ref>. ; Osugi
:: Located behind the main shrine, the tree is estimated to be about 1300 years old, with a trunk circumference of 7 meters and a height of 30 meters. Since {{ill|Hiroyuki Ehara|ja|江原啓之|qid=Q11550701}}'s ``Shinto Travelogue'' was published, many people who were unscrupulous were peeling off the bark of this cedar tree and taking it home with them, so a fence has now been placed around the trunk.

== Festival ==
* January 1st {{ill|Saitan-sai|ja|歳旦祭|qid=Q11546824}}
* February 3rd {{ill|Setsubun|ar|سيتسوبون|az|Setsubun|cs|Secubun|da|Setsubun|de|Setsubun|es|Setsubun|fa|ستسوبون|fi|Setsubun|fr|Setsubun|gd|Setsubun|he|סצובון|hu|Szecubun|hyw|Սեթսապան|id|Setsubun|it|Setsubun|ja|節分|ko|세쓰분|ms|Setsubun|pt|Setsubun|ru|Сэцубун|simple|Setsubun|sq|Setsubun|tr|Setsubun|uk|Сецубун|vi|Setsubun|zh|節分|qid=Q746798|lt=Setsubun Festival}}
** {{ill|Kagura|ar|كاغورا|ca|Kagura|cs|Kagura|de|Kagura|es|Kagura (danza)|fa|کاگورا|fi|Kagura|fr|Kagura|id|Kagura|it|Kagura (danza)|ja|神楽|ko|가구라|lt|Kagura|ms|Kagura|or|କାଗୁରା|pl|Kagura|pt|Kagura|ru|Кагура|sq|Kagura|te|కగుర (నృత్య రీతి)|tr|Kagura|uk|Каґура|vi|Kagura|zh|神樂|qid=Q1348260}} dedication, {{ill|Ōharae-shiki|fa|اوهارائه‌شیکی|fr|Ōharae-shiki|ja|大祓|ko|오하라에|simple|Ōharae-shiki|th|โอฮาราเอะ|qid=Q11261910|lt=Chino Ring}}, and bean-throwing will be held.
*February 17th Prayer Festival
* April 18th {{ill|Reisai|fr|Festival Reisai|ja|例祭|simple|Reisai|qid=Q11385469}}
** Asashi Matsuri - After the regular festival ritual, the festival is carried out from the main shrine to Amaterasu Shrine across the street. |access-date=2022-07-13 |publisher=Susa Shrine Official}}</ref>.
* April 19 Koden Festival
** Ryoou-mai - Performed following the Koden Festival ritual. <ref>{{Cite web|Japanese book|url=https://www.susa-jinja.jp/event/27/29 |title=Ryoou no Mai |access-date=2022-07-13 |publisher=Susa Shrine Official}}</ref>. It is thought that it was originally danced by a divine being of the Onmyoji type, but was transformed into one.** Hundred-handed Shinji - Archery ritual held in the afternoon to pray for the exorcism of demons and a good harvest.
* June 30th {{ill|Ōharae-shiki|fa|اوهارائه‌شیکی|fr|Ōharae-shiki|ja|大祓|ko|오하라에|simple|Ōharae-shiki|th|โอฮาราเอะ|qid=Q11261910}}
* August 15 Kirimei Shinto ritual
** {{ill|nenbutsu odori|ja|念仏踊り|qid=Q11491438}} - Held in the afternoon. Two ritual flowers are erected in the shrine grounds, and beneath them dancers wearing kimono (kimono) form a circle, chanting ``Naamamido'' and dancing monotonously to the beat of the flute. It is a dance with strong {{ill|Shinbutsu-shūgō|de|Shinbutsu-Shūgō|es|Shinbutsu shūgō|eu|Shinbutsu-shūgō|fa|شینبوتسو-شوگو|fi|Shinbutsu shūgō|fr|Shinbutsu shūgō|id|Shinbutsu-shūgō|it|Shinbutsu shūgō|ja|神仏習合|ko|신불습합|pl|Synkretyzm shintō-buddyjski|ru|Синто-буддийский синкретизм|th|ชิมบุตสึชูโง|tr|Şinbutsu-şuugō|uk|Синто-буддистський синкретизм|ur|شنتو اور بدھ مت کا امتزاج ضدین|zh|神佛習合|qid=Q2279088}} color, which is thought to have been influenced by Nembutsu saints in the {{ill|Dengaku|ca|Dengaku|es|Dengaku (música)|fa|دنگاکو|fr|Dengaku|id|Dengaku|it|Dengaku|ja|田楽|ko|덴가쿠 (춤)|pl|Dengaku|ru|Дэнгаку|qid=Q3022455}} style of dance in the medieval period.
* October 17th Autumn Festival
* November 23rd Niinamatsuri
* December 31st Purification
* 15th of every month {{ill|Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|ja|月次祭|simple|Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|qid=Q11516161}}

== Transportation ==
* From {{ill|Izumoshi Station|fr|Gare d'Izumoshi|ja|出雲市駅|jv|Setatsiyun Izumoshi|ko|이즈모시역|my|အိဇုမိုရှိဘူတာ|ur|ایزوموشی اسٹیشن|zh|出雲市站|qid=Q860288}}, take the {{ill|Ichibata Bus|ja|一畑バス|ko|이치바타 버스|zh|一畑巴士|qid=Q11352955}} bound for Izumo Susa and get off at Susa bus stop. 3 km walk.
* If you are using a car, there are over 10 parking spaces next to the temple grounds.
